extracted.name: Alpine fries
extracted.description: Indulge in French fries topped with melted cheese, ham and pickles. Serve as a side dish or an easy snack for entertaining friends and family
instruction_lines: Cook the French fries following pack instructions, then tip into a heatproof dish and top with the raclette cheese and ham. Heat the grill to medium, then grill for 2-3 mins until the cheese is melted and bubbling. Top with the cornichons, season and serve.
